item.title: French presidential frontrunner plots alliance with Nigel Farage to end migrant crisis for good - with Royal Navy to stop the boats
item.description: France’s presidential frontrunner Jordan Bardella is moving to forge an alliance with Reform UK leader Nigel Farage to "restore Europe’s borders" after the pair held talks in London on Tuesday.Mr Bardella, the leader of the National Rally party, pledged to change France’s border policy to support Britain in tackling the Channel small boats crisis should he secure victory in next year's elections.
